cautions: Supplied research and owner specimen observations; independent archived-source review pending. No Shockbase used. Original PDF, photographs and reconstructed service-catalog images are excluded from publication.

Measured dimensions 46.8 × 41.3 × 12.8 mm and weights 64.65 / 64.70 g describe two surviving specimens, not factory values or all color variants. Exact color suffixes were not asserted in the measurement report.
Historical 41.6 mm width and owner-measured 41.3 mm width may use different conventions. Preserve both without substitution. Unmeasured DW-5400C / DW-5500C receive no inferred measurements.
Honda names are collector descriptors, not confirmed Casio SKUs. GSET-30-1 is a package reference. DW-1983-1 is related but outside the 22 canonical heritage records.

Service codes are recorded research associations, not confirmation of original factory installation. Replacement-stock compatibility is separate from original fitment. DW-5000C-1B printed gold-accent crystal remains unresolved; 79000433 was rejected and is not assigned.

Anniversary suffix readings are model-specific; literal expansions remain unverified. DW-5000R is a December 2024 regular-production revival, not a 40th-anniversary limited edition. Regional grouping preserves each original identifier and evidence.
